configurations.name: mutolaa-app
runtimeArgs: for (const k of ['NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL','NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY','SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY','SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF']) delete process.env[k]; require('child_process').spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'mutolaa-app', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }).on('exit', (c) => process.exit(c ?? 0))
